rules.task-report.f3.v2.copy-identity: The copy's record set names this copy, its state, the catalog entry, the catalog SHA-256, the data file, this protocol and the baseline the evaluator holds; anything else is incomplete.
rules.task-report.f3.v2.source-tree: The evaluator recomputes the tree hash from the copy's recorded per-file hashes; it must equal the recorded tree hash, the tree the copy expected and the tree the evaluator expects for the state (clean and fixed: the baseline with the reference repair's result; buggy: the baseline with the planted target file). A copy run on any other tree is incomplete.
rules.task-report.f3.v2.protocol-block-rules: Block rules come from this file. A record whose rules differ from them is incomplete.
rules.task-report.f3.v2.block-replay: Each block's status is recomputed from its ordered trial outcomes under this file's rule. Trials after the rule stops the block, an unfinished block, or a recorded status that differs from the recomputed one make the instance's checks invalid.
rules.task-report.f3.v2.original-suite-complet: An original-suite run counts only when it executed all 193 baseline tests; a missing or skipped test makes the run invalid.
rules.task-report.f3.v2.invalid-trial-not-coun: An invalid trial is never a pass and never a detection.
rules.task-report.f3.v2.every-instance-valid: Every declared instance must give a valid original-suite run and a valid checks run; with fewer, the cell is incomplete.

decision.block: A block runs trials with indices 1, 2, ... until it has valid_target valid trials; each invalid trial is topped up by a trial with the next new index. It is incomplete as soon as it has more than max_invalid invalid trials, or after valid_target + max_top_ups attempts. With these values the invalid ceiling binds first; the top-up cap stays as a hard bound on attempts.
decision.original_suite_cell: pass when every declared instance ran all 193 tests and all passed; fail when every run is valid and at least one test failed; error when the copy or an instance could not be prepared; otherwise incomplete.
decision.verification_cell: pass when every valid trial of every block passed; fail with the declared code when every valid trial equals the data file's buggy vector (every main trial shows the failure, every control passes); fail with the inconsistent or control code for any other failing pattern; error when the copy or an instance could not be prepared; otherwise incomplete.
decision.qualified: Every cell matches the qualification table: original suite pass, pass, pass; verification checks pass, fail with the declared code, pass. A mismatch counts only when every cell's evidence is complete; any error makes the result invalid, and anything else is incomplete.

invalid_trials: never a pass and never a detection; recorded with their codes
retuning: none after the first counted trial; any change to the data file or to this file is a new version
